review.tagline: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose voice assistant client for LiveKit Agents
review.summary: Android Studio project on the LiveKit Android SDK giving you a simple voice interface to a LiveKit agent, scaffolded with lk app create. It connects to the public LiveKit homepage agent by default; to reach your own agent you set a development token server id in TokenExt.kt. Client only: the agent and a production token server are yours to build.
review.audience: Android developers adding a voice agent screen
strengths: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on the official LiveKit Android SDK
Works immediately against the public LiveKit homepage agent
Pairs with the Python and Node agent starters
weaknesses: Token server id is hardcoded in TokenExt.kt; production token flow is yours
README does not document video, text input or avatar support
needs: Needs LiveKit Cloud project, a LiveKit agent, token server
